newsitem.title: USA: Nextel to buy Wireless Ventures stake.
newsitem.headline: Nextel to buy Wireless Ventures stake.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc said on Tuesday it has a definitive agreement to buy 81 percent of the stock of Wireless Ventures of Brazil Inc for about $186 million of Nextel stock.

The company said Wireless Ventures of Brazil, based in Virginia, is the largest specialized mobile radio (SMR) operator in Brazil. It is principally owned by Telecom Ventures, the indirect majority shareholder of LCC International Inc.

Wireless Ventures and its affiliated companies are the largest SMR license holders in Brazil, owning or having options to acquire more than 1,300 channels in areas where more than 60 million people live, Nextel said.

"Brazil is a market that still has major needs for telecommunications infrastructure and we believe we can deliver a high-quality wireless alternative at a competitive price to possibly one of the most attractive wireless markets in the world," said Daniel Akerson, Nextel's chairman and chief executive.
The deal is expected to close by the end of the year.

The company said its McCaw International Ltd unit will use Motorola Inc's integrated digital enhanced network (iDEN) technology and already has a financing commitment from Motorola for $125 million to complete the initial build-out of the iDEN systems in each of the major cities in Brazil.
